name: Jenni
description_en:
Jenni is a research-writing workspace combining a source library, assisted drafting, citations, library chat and manuscript review. It can import PDFs or reference-manager material and connect suggested text to source locations. This is a writing-and-evidence workflow, not evidence that every generated claim is correct.

The author still needs to verify what each source actually supports. Current plans meter autocomplete, edits, chat, reviews, workflow runs and uploads separately, while free export differs from full-document export. An unlimited-citations label does not remove the limits on AI assistance.
description_zh:
Jenni 将来源库、辅助写作、引用、文献聊天及稿件检查放在研究工作区，可导入 PDF 或参考管理器资料，并把建议文字连接到来源位置。这是写作与证据流程，不证明所有生成主张正确。

作者仍需核实来源真正支持什么。现行套餐分别计量补全、编辑、聊天、检查、流程和上传，免费导出也不同于完整文档。不限引用不取消 AI 辅助上限。

core_features.explanation_en: Use selected library material and inspect linked source locations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用所选文献并检查关联来源位置。

core_features.explanation_en: Ask about imported documents and inspect flagged manuscript claims.
core_features.explanation_zh: 询问导入文档并核对标记的稿件主张。

en: Draft a source-checked literature-review paragraph and inspect its citation in export.
zh: 起草有来源核对的综述段落，并检查导出引用。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Import one nonconfidential paper, verify a suggested claim in the PDF and export the citation/reference list in the target format.
steps.zh: 导入一篇非机密论文，在 PDF 验证建议主张，并按目标格式导出引用/参考文献。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Separate AI-action/upload allowances by subscription tier, with document export entitlements.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free limited AI actions and uploads; Plus displays USD $12/month, Pro $29/month with unresolved selected billing control. Plus includes 5,000 monthly autocompletes, 500 edits/chats and ten reviews/workflows; Pro unlimited AI functions subject to confirming fair use. Full export/upload size and renewal require confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 免费 AI 动作/上传有限；Plus 展示美元月 $12、Pro $29，所选账期未清。Plus 月 5,000 补全、500 编辑/聊天、10 检查/流程，Pro 宣传 AI 不限但需核合理使用。完整导出、上传大小及续费需确认。

sources.title: Jenni | AI Academic Writer & Research Tool for Students & Academics
sources.research_notes_en: Research writing workspace with library import, source-linked suggestions, PDF chat, review and exports; no citation accuracy independently validated.

sources.title: Jenni AI Pricing & Plans | Find the Right Plan for Your Writing
sources.research_notes_en: Free limited actions versus Plus/Pro; USD cards $12/$29 with billing selector not unambiguously resolved, upload/export limits matter.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Check the source’s support, not just the citation format
sections.title_zh: 核对来源支持程度，而非仅引用格式
sections.en: For an illustrative literature-review paragraph, import a permitted paper, ask about one finding and inspect the original passage before accepting autocomplete. A correctly formatted reference can still support a weaker claim than the generated wording. Check study population, numbers, uncertainty and whether the source is a primary study or review. Reviews can flag issues, but was not independently validated here.
sections.zh: 例如文献综述，应导入允许使用的论文，询问一项发现，接受补全前检查原段。格式正确的引用也可能只支持比生成措辞更弱的主张。应核对样本、数字、不确定性及原始研究/综述身份。Reviews 可标记问题，但本文未独立验证。

sections.title_en: Test the final exported research document
sections.title_zh: 测试最终导出的研究文档
sections.en: The product describes PDF/reference-manager import, library chat, citation styles and DOCX, LaTeX or HTML export. Free lists body-content export, while paid plans list full export. Pilot one citation, reference list, table and non-English passage in the actual target format. No import, coauthoring, citation, calculation or export was executed; homepage example papers and counts were not audited.
sections.zh: 产品介绍 PDF/参考管理器导入、文献聊天、引用样式及 DOCX、LaTeX、HTML 导出。免费列正文导出，付费列完整导出，应在目标格式试验引用、参考文献、表格和非英语段落。本文未执行导入、共编、引用、计算或导出，也未审计演示论文与数量。

sections.title_en: Separate daily autocomplete from other allowances
sections.title_zh: 区分每日补全与其他额度
sections.en: Free lists ten autocomplete suggestions/day, ten PDF uploads, three edits, five chats, three reviews and three workflow runs; the reset period for every non-autocomplete limit is not clear in the extracted text. Plus lists 5,000 monthly autocompletes, 500 edits/chats and ten reviews/runs. Pro advertises unlimited AI functions. Cards show USD $12 and $29 per month beside annual/monthly controls, so confirm the selected renewal total and fair use instead of assuming monthly billing.
sections.zh: 免费列每日 10 补全、10 PDF 上传、3 编辑、5 聊天、3 检查和 3 流程；抽取文字未清楚说明所有非补全额度的重置周期。Plus 列月 5,000 补全、500 编辑/聊天和 10 检查/流程，Pro 宣传 AI 功能不限。月/年选择旁卡片显示美元月 $12/$29，需确认续费总额与合理使用，不能直接假定月付。

sections.title_en: Use a research assistant with an accountable author
sections.title_zh: 由负责作者使用研究助手
sections.en: Jenni merits investigation for source-based drafting and reference handling. It should not replace reading the cited paper or a qualified review of consequential research. Confirm document privacy, upload limits and full-export rights before importing unpublished material. No source-code license or self-hosted package was verified; citation accuracy, language quality and claimed time savings remain untested.
sections.zh: 需要有来源起草和参考处理时可研究 Jenni，不能代替阅读原论文或重要研究的合格审核。导入未发表资料前需确认隐私、上传上限和完整导出权益。本次未确认源码许可、自托管，引用准确性、语言质量和节时主张未测试。

research_gaps: No document, citation, library chat, review, collaboration, code calculation or export was tested.
Selected billing, free-action reset, fair use, file/privacy limits, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
